coverage.component_basis: Shared components C1-C12 (Phase 5 specification 3.0.0 §15); a component counts when one of its qualifying assertions executed in this run, pass or fail; setup, preparation and skips earn no credit. HTTP-only run: C9 (user interface) needs retained browser/keyboard evidence and is not counted.
coverage.system_basis: Exercised-criterion coverage of AC-01 to AC-18 (Phase 5 specification 3.0.0 §14, §17): a criterion counts once when a mapped qualifying assertion executed, pass or fail; this is not acceptance success. AC-09 counts only the automated preservation checks (Microsoft Excel inspection is separate); AC-17 needs UI evidence an HTTP-only run cannot supply.
